# 02.00 Agent guide


Use this file as the repository working agreement. Read the following
preconditions before changing code:

1. `feature-catalog.instructions.md` — ID-addressable catalog of xaligo's

   commit workflow.
3. `../05-issues-quality/05-00-issues-and-quality-overview.instructions.md` — open quality and feature-hardening issues,
  design quality, and completion gates.
4. `../06-roadmap/06-00-roadmap-overview.instructions.md` — product and pipeline direction.
5. `../07-xal-spec/07-01-xal-specification-overview.instructions.md` — authoritative `.xal` behavior.
6. `../08-architecture/08-00-architecture-overview.instructions.md` — package boundaries and dependency rules.
7. `../09-coding/09-00-coding-overview.instructions.md` — mandatory file and identifier conventions.
